counting.confirmed: no real game effect in this lane => confirmed = 0
counting.expected_actions: records minus navigation (null arrays/placeholders do not count as actions)
counting.group_toggles: group checkbox with a CE own effect: own locked bucket, no record action
counting.groups: counted separately, not as record actions
counting.statuses: statically_assumed / locked / unknown; unknown stays unknown

convention.priority_rule: per-table priority_order is the fixed category priority restricted to the table's non-zero categories; the campaign walks value_freeze first and script lifecycles last
convention.record_map: records maps str(record id) to the record's static category; report observations may only reference these ids
